why: §44, amended 2026-09-30 by the owner: reading, deriving and archiving are three different rights and one licence flag may never decide all three. This registry records them independently, per source. The contract and its invariants are in src/lib/hunt/source-rights.ts, which refuses the combinations §44 forbids — unstated terms may not block derived facts, and may not permit archiving.

source:us-ma-hunting-season-summary.whyThisIsTheAcceptanceCase: The owner named Massachusetts: public authority, no assumed open-data licence, structured fact extraction, no unnecessary republication, full provenance. Every one of those holds here. The facts below are North Ground's own structured records citing the authority; nothing of the authority's prose is reproduced beyond what §8 allows, and no copy is stored.
source:us-ma-hunting-season-summary.whatIsNOTClaimed: This page is a SUMMARY and says so — "These pages provide a summary of the regulations and statutes that relate to hunting and trapping in Massachusetts". The codified instrument is 321 CMR 3.00, which is linked from it and has NOT been read, because the routes to Massachusetts's code are the ones that failed. So these facts are recorded at GOVERNMENT_SUMMARY authority, not PRIMARY_GOVERNMENT, and a season that turns on the codified wording is not settled by them.

us-ma-2026-seasons.note: Recorded as evidence, not as a certified bundle. Turning these into the regulatory engine's own bundle format, with cases, is the remaining step and is not claimed here.
fiveThingsInTHISSOURCEThatAResolverWould: ZONE SCOPE IS NOT UNIFORM. Bobcat is Zones 1–8 ONLY and wild turkey is Zones 1–13, while most species are 1–14. A model that read "Massachusetts has 14 zones" and applied every season statewide would authorise bobcat in six zones where it is closed.

A CROSS-SPECIES CONDITION. Eleven species carry an asterisk meaning "Closed during shotgun deer season" — so their seasons are interrupted by ANOTHER species' season, 2026-11-30 to 2026-12-12. A date inside a listed range is not thereby open.
A DAY-OF-WEEK RESTRICTION. Crow is open "Mon, Fri, Sat only". A date-range model answers Wednesday wrongly.

ONE ROW OMITS ITS YEAR. Primitive Firearms Deer Season reads "Dec. 14–31" where every other row carries a year. 2026 is the obvious reading and it is still an inference about the source's formatting rather than a stated fact, so it is flagged rather than silently completed.

YEAR-ROUND SPECIES WITH NO BAG LIMIT. English sparrow, flying squirrel, red squirrel, chipmunk, porcupine, skunk, starling, weasel and woodchuck may be taken year-round with no daily or seasonal limit — except during shotgun deer season. That is the seasons analogue of Iowa's NO_RESTRICTION hours: an affirmative absence of limit, not a missing record.
us-ma-2026-seasons.andOneBoundaryOfTheSOURCEITSELF: Falconry carries its own windows — pheasant, quail, grouse, cottontail, hare and gray squirrel "from the respective opening day through March 14", and crow during the regular season — so the hunter's METHOD changes the season end. That is a real rule and it is not in the tables above.
